title: Business Director — what they may and may not do in Sales

steps.do: Open Left menu → Sales and each tile in turn: Leads, Opportunities, Inquiries, Quotes, Quote templates, Pre-order checklist, Project costing, Approvals, Pipelines & funnels, Set up Sales.
steps.expect: Opens exactly what the matrix allows; anything else is refused with a sentence (never a blank page or an error).
steps.observed: Leads: opens; Opportunities: opens; Inquiries: opens; Quotes: opens; Quote templates: refused ("You cannot manage CRM templates.") [no tile — address typed]; Pre-order checklist: refused ("You cannot configure the pre-order checklist.") [no tile — address typed]; Project costing: opens; Approvals: opens; Pipelines & funnels: opens; Set up Sales: refused ("Only someone who may change the Sales settings can answer these questi") [no tile — address typed]

steps.do: Try what the permission matrix says they may do: See every branch, approve, Insights.
steps.observed: Register lists both the Ahmedabad and the Mumbai quotation; the Director signed level 3 last ("All approvals complete — quote approved and ready to send."); Insights and the Sales dashboard open.

steps.do: Try what the matrix says they may NOT do: Delete records unless administrator.
steps.expect: Each is refused (button absent, or a refusal sentence when the address is typed).
steps.observed: The Director (not an administrator) is offered a "Delete" button on the deal and a Delete on the enquiry register — and pressing it DELETED the deal ("Opportunity OPP-2026-0001 deleted.")

steps.do: Type the address of a refused screen directly.
steps.expect: Refused the same way — hiding the button is not enough.
steps.observed: a re-sent "inquiry-delete" form deleted the enquiry for the Director
